newsitem.title: UK: Wiseman sets shr issue, buys Scotpride milk.
newsitem.headline: Wiseman sets shr issue, buys Scotpride milk.

text.p: British dairy company Robert Wiseman Dairies Plc said on Monday it planned to acquire some assets of fresh food company Scottish Pride Limited, currently in receivership, and would make a share placing to raise 12.2 million stg at 172p a share.
In a statement Wiseman said it had agreed to spend 4.8 million stg cash on a milk bottling plants, depots, goodwill and the "Fresh 'N' Lo" semi-skimmed milk brand trademark in Scotland.

Wiseman said that within the placing of shares, fully underwritten by Panmure Gordon & Co, firm placing had already been ensured from directors in respect of just over 4.54 million new shares out of a total of nearly 7.89 million shares.

"We are delighted to have made this acquisition which complements our existing facilities and further strengthens the group's position as a financially strong Scottish-based dairy processor," company chairman Alan Wiseman said.
